definition: to return something to its place
description: In a flooded museum hall with a leaking glass roof, where rain pours down in a stream, two monkeys in small aprons and white gloves stand on a stone pedestal and guide an ancient clay jar, hanging in a rope sling from a beam, back down onto its place until it stands on the pedestal. Another monkey climbs the rope above, one on a wooden crate holds a board and a lit torch, and one sits in the water on the marble floor. Glass cases, a stepladder, a fallen bust and coils of rope fill the hall.

en.question: Where are the monkeys putting the jar?

de.answer: Sie stellen ihn zurück auf den Sockel.
de.question: Wohin stellen die Affen den Krug?

es.answer: La están volviendo a poner en el pedestal.
es.question: ¿Dónde están poniendo la vasija los monos?

fr.answer: Ils la remettent sur le piédestal.
fr.question: Où les singes posent-ils la jarre ?
